integrity: note: forward records are canonical winner-first (label always 1); reverse are the swapped mirror (label always 0)

config.split: leave-one-real-dataset-out, 80/20 train/cal by sample_uid, seed 20260901 (same as incumbent)
config.sample_weight: w_p = 1 / (S_train * N_train(source(p))); every training source totals 1/S_train
config.tournament_score: p(c≻KEEP) + mean p(c≻j) over eligible j!=c; KEEP vector fixed to zeros; score symmetrised as 0.5*(f(d)+1-f(-d))
config.learning_metric_convention: forward pairs canonical winner-first (label always 1); accuracy identical under exact antisymmetry; AUROC/AUPRC computed on both directions
